capabilities: Insert natural language dates as wikilinks or plain text via chrono-node parsing
Discover and expand Templater templates inline at the cursor
Fuzzy-search vault markdown files and YAML frontmatter aliases
Configure a single trigger character (default @) for all suggestion types
Keep natural language text as a link alias with Shift+Enter
extras: Template discovery falls back to Obsidian's core Templates plugin or a custom folder if Templater is not used.
intentEvidence: Built on the date-parsing foundation of Natural Language Dates (nldates-obsidian)
problem: Separate autocomplete plugins use different trigger symbols and produce conflicting suggestion popups, so users juggle multiple triggers for dates, templates, and file links.

relations.evidence: Natural language date parsing and configuration model based on nldates-obsidian
Automatically discovers templates from your Templater template folder

summary: Unified @-trigger autocomplete popup that inserts natural language dates, expands Templater templates inline, and links vault files and aliases.
